_about: Postgame. The first three chapters were played in the natural run (natural-run-v102 rows 207–211). The rest are written from game data and the project’s own audits and are flagged `source` so the page says so. The nine Silph Conspiracy chapters (v1.3) were played in the v1.3 NEW GAME playthrough and are written from that run and the release's story scripts.

chapters.title: After the Credits
chapters.goal: Find your feet as Champion of three regions and learn how to travel between them.
need: Hoenn League Champion.
quick: Continue from the title screen
You resume in Littleroot Town outside Professor Birch’s lab with your party healed.
Answer Brendan’s call
On your first steps outdoors after the credits, Brendan calls: the Silph Conspiracy begins. See the next chapter.
Talk to Professor Birch
He is in his lab and points you to the truck.
Use the truck to reach Kanto
Rear door, east end, from below: ‘Call the truck to Pallet Town?’
Fly anywhere
In Kanto and Johto the Fly map is the combined Johto–Kanto map again.

p: The truck is the link between Hoenn and the older regions. In Littleroot, stand below the rear door at the truck’s east end and press A: it offers to take you to Pallet Town and reminds you that you can return any time. The same door in Pallet brings you back.
Fly uses the map of the region you are standing in. After the truck ride to Pallet, every Johto and Kanto town you have visited is available again.
The ferry S.S. Tidal sails inside Hoenn between Slateport and Lilycove; the S.S. Aqua sails between Olivine and Vermilion. They are separate ships with separate tickets.

Becoming Champion of the Hoenn League now opens a new story, the Silph Conspiracy. Brendan calls on your Pokégear the first time you step outdoors after the credits and asks you to meet him in Professor Birch’s Lab. The next chapters cover it from start to finish.

stuck: How do I return to Pallet Town from Hoenn?
Fly to Littleroot Town. At the truck, stand below the rear door at its east end, face up and press A, then choose Yes.
Where am I after the Hoenn credits?
Choose Continue on the title screen. You are in Littleroot Town, outside Professor Birch’s lab.
next: Talk to Brendan in Professor Birch’s Lab.
chapters.ev: v102 trace 207–208, 210–211; v1.3: Brendan’s call from the v1.3 NEW GAME playthrough and the release save tests

chapters.title: Brendan’s Call
chapters.ev: v1.3 NEW GAME playthrough (blonde/qa/phase5p-new-game-20261017: progression, scenes, battles) and the story scripts of the release (Phase 5P acts.py / text.json)
chapters.goal: Answer Brendan’s call and hear what has gone missing.
need: Hoenn League Champion (the story starts only after you have won the Hoenn League).
A strong, fully trained team: the story’s battles are at Level 95–100.
quick: Step outside after becoming Hoenn Champion
Brendan calls on your Pokégear: DEVON shipments bound for Silph Co. have vanished.
Talk to May outside Professor Birch’s Lab
She says Brendan has been at the ledgers all night.
Talk to Brendan in the lab
Forty crates left DEVON; the news named Vermilion Harbor in Kanto. He leaves for the docks.
Talk to May again outside
She is heading to Kanto too, to follow the uneasy Pokémon near Saffron.
Take the truck to Pallet Town, then fly to Vermilion City
The truck’s rear door at its east end in Littleroot, as after the credits.

p: The Silph Conspiracy is postgame content. Once you are Champion of the Hoenn League, Brendan calls you on the Pokégear the first time you take a few steps outdoors. On a new game this happens right after the Hoenn credits; on an older save that is already Hoenn Champion, it happens on your first steps outside after updating. The call plays once.
If you saved inside a building, walk outside first. Before you have won the Hoenn League there is no call and nothing changes.

May is outside the lab. Inside, Brendan explains that DEVON cargo for Silph Co. went missing on the way, and Professor Birch points out that the news named a harbor: Vermilion, in Kanto. Brendan heads for the docks and asks you to meet him there.

From this moment the Kanto Gym Leaders are busy with the investigation. Their Gyms are empty and the Gym guides tell you where each Leader has gone. They return when the story is over, so do any Kanto Gym rematches first if you want them now.
Use the truck in Littleroot (rear door at its east end) to reach Pallet Town, then fly to Vermilion City. Professor Birch repeats where to go if you talk to him again.

stuck: Brendan never called.

You must have won the Hoenn League. Then walk outside anywhere: the call needs an outdoor map. If you are not sure whether it already played, visit Professor Birch’s Lab: he tells you where the story is.
The Kanto Gym Leaders are missing.
They are part of the investigation. They return to their Gyms once Silph Co. is safe again.

chapters.title: Vermilion Harbor
chapters.ev: v1.3 NEW GAME playthrough (blonde/qa/phase5p-new-game-20261017: progression, scenes, battles) and the story scripts of the release (Phase 5P acts.py / text.json)
chapters.goal: Meet Brendan on the Vermilion pier and pick up the first leads.
need: Brendan’s call and the lab scene.
quick: Walk onto the pier at Vermilion Harbor
Brendan, Misty and Lt. Surge meet you there.
Listen to the whole scene
Forty crates left DEVON for Silph; only twelve arrived.
Note the three leads
Brock on Route 3 by Mt. Moon, Janine in Fuchsia City, and Blaine in the cave behind his Seafoam Gym.
Talk to Brendan any time
He stays with the crates and lists the leads you have not followed yet.

p: Brendan has read the harbor’s cargo manifests: forty crates left DEVON for Silph Co., twelve arrived, and twenty-eight are unaccounted for. Misty followed an unlit boat to this pier. Lt. Surge arrives, says the harbor is his beat and takes the records with him. Brendan and Misty notice that he never asked what was in the crates.
Brendan finds a strange coil among the cargo and sends a sketch of it to Blaine. Misty tells you Brock found cart tracks near Mt. Moon; Brendan adds that Janine has a lead in Fuchsia City.
Brock (Route 3, by Mt. Moon), Janine (Fuchsia City) and Blaine (the cave behind the Seafoam Gym) can be visited in any order. When all three are done, Blue is waiting at the Viridian Gym.
Misty stays on the pier, watching for the boat. Her Starmie, Staryu and Gyarados swim in the water beside it.

stuck: Where do I go after the pier?
Talk to Brendan on the pier: he lists the leads you still have to follow.
next: Route 3 by Mt. Moon, and Fuchsia City.

chapters.title: Brock & Janine
chapters.ev: v1.3 NEW GAME playthrough (blonde/qa/phase5p-new-game-20261017: progression, scenes, battles) and the story scripts of the release (Phase 5P acts.py / text.json)
need: The Vermilion Harbor scene.
quick: Find Brock on Route 3, near the Mt. Moon entrance
Talk to him and he says “Walk with me.”
Follow Brock
Heavy carts crossed the route at night; he found a Silph loading tag.
Find Janine in Fuchsia City
Three couriers used her father Koga’s old routes.

p: Brock walks you along the route. Heavy carts crossed it at night, and he found a Silph loading tag nearby: cargo from Vermilion should never come this way. He stays to watch the tunnel and sends you to Blaine, who knows machines.
Janine is in town, not in her Gym. Three couriers used her father’s old routes, paths he taught to very few people. She wants his explanation herself and asks you to tell Blue in Viridian.

stuck: Janine is not in the Fuchsia Gym.
During the story she waits in Fuchsia City itself. The Gym guide says she went out.

chapters.title: Blaine’s Cave
chapters.sub: A quiz, a coil and an old friend
chapters.ev: v1.3 NEW GAME playthrough (blonde/qa/phase5p-new-game-20261017: progression, scenes, battles) and the story scripts of the release (Phase 5P acts.py / text.json)
chapters.goal: Examine Blaine’s old lab and answer his quiz.
need: The Vermilion Harbor scene.
quick: Go through the back of the Seafoam Gym
The opening in the Gym’s north wall leads to a cave.
Examine all four things in the lab
The growth tank, the canisters, the design file and the staff photo.
Talk to Blaine and answer his quiz
What did Cinnabar create? The answer is MEWTWO.
Watch what happens next
Blaine’s old receiver picks up a signal.

p: Blaine’s Gym on the Seafoam Islands has its back entrance open again. The cave behind it holds Blaine’s old research equipment. He asks you to look around before his quiz: an empty growth tank labelled SPECIMEN TWO, sealed canisters paid for from Viridian City, a shelved design file called RECALL RELAY, MARK ONE, and a staff photo from Cinnabar.

His quiz offers MEWTWO, DITTO and DEOXYS. Only MEWTWO is right; a wrong answer simply lets you try again. Blaine explains that the coil Brendan sketched is part of a recall system, a machine that could force Pokémon back against their will, and that someone is finishing that research at Silph.
Then his old receiver picks up a signal, and what follows depends on your game:
If you own Mewtwo (in your party or in a PC box), it appears beside Blaine, who greets an old friend.
If Mewtwo is still waiting in Cerulean Cave, it appears for a moment, having sensed the signal from there, and then goes home. It is still there to catch afterwards.
If Mewtwo is gone (neither in Cerulean Cave nor yours), nothing answers.
Nothing is caught, released or changed in any case. Blaine ends by saying the machine has a weak point, and sends you on to Janine or Blue.

stuck: Blaine says to look around first.
Examine all four objects in the lab (tank, canisters, file, photo), then talk to him again.
The cave is foggy.
That is the cave’s own weather. It does not hide anything you need.

chapters.title: Blue in Viridian
chapters.ev: v1.3 NEW GAME playthrough (blonde/qa/phase5p-new-game-20261017: progression, scenes, battles) and the story scripts of the release (Phase 5P acts.py / text.json)
chapters.goal: Bring every Leader’s report to Blue.
need: Brock’s, Janine’s and Blaine’s leads.
quick: Talk to Blue in the Viridian Gym
If a lead is missing he says which one.
Hear his briefing
Someone searched Giovanni’s old office and took files.
Go to Saffron City’s west entrance
Erika is there. Blue goes ahead to Silph Co.

p: Blue wants every Leader’s report first. With all three, he puts it together: missing freight, Silph tags and night routes, and someone searched Giovanni’s old office for files, not trophies. Someone is rebuilding an old Team Rocket operation, and Saffron must be warned. He sends you to Erika at Saffron’s west entrance then recalls his Arcanine and flies off to Silph Co.

stuck: Blue says “Not yet.”
He lists the Leaders you have not heard from: Brock on Route 3, Blaine behind the Seafoam Gym, or Janine in Fuchsia City.

chapters.title: Saffron Under Siege
chapters.ev: v1.3 NEW GAME playthrough (blonde/qa/phase5p-new-game-20261017: progression, scenes, battles) and the story scripts of the release (Phase 5P acts.py / text.json)
chapters.goal: Help Erika clear the streets, join the Leaders at Silph Co. and get inside.
need: Blue’s briefing in Viridian.
quick: Enter Saffron City from the west
Erika is directing the evacuation to Celadon.
Talk to Erika
Team Rocket holds Silph Co. May arrives from the east streets.
Meet Blue and the Leaders at the Silph Co. doors
Blue, Lt. Surge, Sabrina, Brendan and May are there.
Go into the lobby
A scene, then two Rocket Grunts one after the other.
Erika heals your team
She offers healing for the rest of the siege.

p: Erika is at the west entrance asking people to keep left; Celadon has beds for everyone. Talk to her: Team Rocket holds Silph Co. and the workers are still inside. May reports that the east streets are clear. From now on Erika offers to heal your Pokémon, first at the west entrance and, once the siege has started, by the Silph Co. doors.

Blue has the Leaders together: Brock holds the tunnels, Misty the harbor, Erika the streets. Lt. Surge goes to check the building’s power grid, Sabrina senses many minds inside, and Brendan says the stolen crates went up the freight lift. Blue’s orders: find the workers first, then stop the machine.

Inside, Lt. Surge seals the lifts and the security doors, then admits he served Team Rocket long before he wore a Badge. Two Rocket Grunts attack, one after the other. When they are beaten, Blue tells you May will meet you upstairs: start on 3F.

bosses.title: Rocket Grunts in the lobby
know: Two battles in a row, Level 95–96: Arbok and Weezing, then Raticate and Houndoom.
Erika can heal you outside between attempts.

stuck: Blue says to see Erika first.
Go to Saffron City’s west entrance and talk to Erika before the briefing.
The stairs are closed.
Before the siege begins only Silph staff may go upstairs. Follow the scene in the lobby first.

chapters.title: Inside Silph Co.
chapters.ev: v1.3 NEW GAME playthrough (blonde/qa/phase5p-new-game-20261017: progression, scenes, battles) and the story scripts of the release (Phase 5P acts.py / text.json)
chapters.goal: Free the workers, get the security clearance and deal with Lt. Surge, Sabrina and Koga.
need: The lobby scene.
quick: 3F: partner battle with May
Six workers are trapped behind a door guarded by two Rockets.
Use the warp panel in that room
It takes you to 7F, where Blue explains the way ahead.
5F: partner battle with Brendan
At the security terminal. He gives you Silph’s security clearance: Card Key doors now open.
5F: Lt. Surge in the security room
Behind a Card Key door.
8F: Sabrina
Blue will not let you past the 7F warp panel to the top until she is beaten.
9F: Koga
Janine confronts her father behind a Card Key door.
7F: the freed employee
Opens the storeroom with the hidden prototype stock.

p: May on 3F and Brendan on 5F fight beside you in two-on-two battles. Before each one you choose three of your Pokémon; your partner brings three of their own at Level 96–98, and their Pokémon depend on your starter. A Pokémon you revive during these battles now waits in your party instead of taking your partner’s empty spot, which fixes a softlock from earlier versions.
Your full party is back as it was afterwards. If you lose, you black out and can try again; the story keeps its progress.

On 3F, May leads the six workers out to Erika and points you to the warp panel inside the same room: it goes to 7F, where Blue says that panel leads near the top, but the office stays sealed for now. Go back through the panel to 3F and take the stairs up to 5F, where Brendan is at the security terminal.
After Brendan’s battle you have Silph’s security clearance. It opens the Card Key doors in the building, though not Giovanni’s office. Lt. Surge has locked himself in the 5F security room.
Lt. Surge (5F), Sabrina (8F) and Koga (9F) can be dealt with in any order. Blue guards the 7F warp panel to the top floor until Sabrina is beaten.

On 9F, behind a Card Key door, Janine confronts Koga about the couriers who used his routes. Koga admits he was one of Giovanni’s people before he joined the Elite Four, and that he helped him again. Janine challenges him as a Gym Leader: you watch her Venomoth face his Crobat. Afterwards she tells you Blaine has gone up to the machine and takes her father out.

On 7F, a Rocket guards the closed meeting room. Beat him and the employee inside opens the storeroom where the staff hid the prototype stock: take what helps. There are more items on the floors, from the moment the siege starts.
The Saffron Poké Mart stays open if you need Max Potions and Full Heals between battles, and Erika heals your team by the Silph Co. doors.

bosses.title: Partner battle with May
know: Two Rocket Grunts at Level 96: Weezing, Honchkrow and Crobat, then Muk, Drapion and Nidoking.
Choose three Pokémon. Ground moves are risky: your partner is on the field too.

bosses.title: Partner battle with Brendan
know: Two Scientists at Level 96–97: Magnezone, Porygon-Z and Electrode, then Alakazam, Rotom and Magmortar.
Alakazam is fast and fragile: knock it out first.

bosses.title: Lt. Surge
know: Six Pokémon at Level 98–99, ending with Mega Raichu Y.
Ground types are immune to his Electric moves; Lanturn and Magnezone take hits well, so bring plenty of healing.

bosses.title: Sabrina
know: Six Pokémon at Level 98–99, ending with Mega Alakazam.
One of the hardest battles of the story: Dark and Ghost moves, X Speed and X Attack, and a fast Mega of your own help.

stuck: Blue won’t let me use the warp panel on 7F.
Beat Sabrina on 8F first.
A door says I need a Card Key.
Win the partner battle with Brendan on 5F: his security clearance opens every Card Key door except Giovanni’s office.
Blaine on 10F says to take care of the others first.
Deal with Lt. Surge, Sabrina and Koga, then come back to him.

chapters.title: The Recall Machine
chapters.ev: v1.3 NEW GAME playthrough (blonde/qa/phase5p-new-game-20261017: progression, scenes, battles) and the story scripts of the release (Phase 5P acts.py / text.json)
chapters.goal: Shut down Giovanni’s machine, stop him in his office and see Silph Co. restored.
need: Lt. Surge, Sabrina and Koga dealt with (Silph Co. 5F, 8F and 9F).
quick: 10F: talk to Blaine
Three cooling pumps power the recall machine. Shut them down in the right order.
INTAKE first
The panel in the south-west office.
LOOP second
The terminal past the east door.
CORE FEED last
North-east, beside the warp pad.
Take the 7F warp panel to the top
The office door opens once the machine is dark.
Giovanni and Archer
A two-on-two battle with your rival at your side.
Go down to the lobby
The victory gathering, and the President’s Master Ball.

p: Blaine is on 10F. The recall machine is cooled by three pumps, and they must be shut down in order: INTAKE (the panel in the south-west office), then LOOP (the terminal past the east door), then CORE FEED (north-east, beside the warp pad). Each panel asks whether to shut its pump down.

The wrong order sets off an alarm and every pump starts up again. Partial progress is also lost if you leave the floor or black out, so when you come back, start again from INTAKE. A pump that is already off says so. Talk to Blaine if you forget the order. Rockets and Scientists guard the offices on the way.
When the third pump stops, the machine goes dark and Blaine sends you up: Giovanni is right above you.

The top floor is reached by the warp panel on 7F (the stairs and lifts do not reach the office side). A guard stands before the office door. The door is a Card Key door that stays locked until the machine is off.

Inside, Giovanni is pressing the Silph President to sign. Your rival walks in, and the battle is two-on-two: you and your rival against Giovanni and Archer. Choose three Pokémon. Giovanni leads with Mega Kangaskhan; Archer with Mega Houndoom. Your rival’s team depends on your starter.
If you lose, you black out and can come back. The pumps stay off.

With the machine silent, Giovanni withdraws Team Rocket, and there is a moment between him and your rival. Then go down to the lobby, where Blue is waiting with the Leaders, Brendan, May and the Silph President.
The President gives you a Master Ball, once. If your Bag is full, he keeps it for you: collect it later from his office on the top floor.
Blue tells you Koga has gone to the Indigo Plateau to face Lance. Silph Co. is back at work, and the Kanto Gym Leaders return to their Gyms.

bosses.title: Giovanni & Archer
know: Giovanni: six Pokémon at Level 99–100 with Mega Kangaskhan, Ursaluna and Nidoking. Archer: five at Level 99–100 with Mega Houndoom.
Your rival fights beside you with Pokémon at Level 96–100. Choose three of yours; a Fighting type and a Water or Ground type cover most of their teams.

items: From the Silph President at the victory gathering. One only; if your Bag is full, collect it from his office later.
stuck: An alarm went off and every pump restarted.
The order is INTAKE, LOOP, CORE FEED. Start again from INTAKE.
I did INTAKE, left and came back, and LOOP sets off the alarm.
Leaving the floor or blacking out resets the pumps you had shut. Do all three again in order.
The office door won’t open.
Shut all three cooling pumps on 10F first, then reach the top floor by the 7F warp panel.
I didn’t get the Master Ball.
Your Bag was full. Make room and talk to the President in his office on the top floor.

chapters.title: A New Elite Four
chapters.sub: Koga steps down; Eusine takes his seat
chapters.ev: v1.3 NEW GAME playthrough (blonde/qa/phase5p-new-game-20261017: progression, scenes, battles) and the story scripts of the release (Phase 5P acts.py / text.json)
chapters.goal: See Koga resign, then challenge the Elite Four with Eusine in the second room.
need: The victory gathering at Silph Co.
quick: Fly to the Indigo Plateau
Koga, Lance and Janine are in the Pokémon Center.
Talk to Koga
He resigns his seat. Lance accepts and opens the League again.
Challenge the Elite Four
Will, then Eusine in Koga’s old room, then Bruno, Karen and Champion Lance.

p: In the Indigo Plateau Pokémon Center, Koga tells Lance that he served Team Rocket before the League and helped them again, and resigns his seat. Lance accepts and says the actions of Lt. Surge and Sabrina will be reviewed. Janine keeps the Fuchsia Gym. Lance tells you the League is open again.
The first time you reach the second room, Lance is there to introduce its new member: Eusine takes Koga’s place. From then on it is simply Eusine’s room.

Eusine fights with Hypno, Electrode, Arcanine, Milotic, Politoed and Mega Gengar at Level 67–68, at the strength of the other Elite Four rematches. Gengar is Ghost and Poison: Ground, Psychic, Ghost and Dark moves hit it hard. The rest of the challenge is Will, Bruno, Karen and Champion Lance as before, and a win leads to the Hall of Fame.

bosses.title: Elite Four Eusine
know: Mega Gengar is fast and hits hard with special moves: a Dark type with good Special Defense handles it best.
Milotic and Politoed are bulky Water types: Electric and Grass moves wear them down.

stuck: Koga is still in the Elite Four.
Finish the Silph Conspiracy (the victory gathering in the Silph Co. lobby), then talk to Koga in the Indigo Plateau Pokémon Center.
next: The Kanto Gym Leaders are back in their Gyms.

chapters.title: Hoenn Gym Rematches
chapters.goal: Challenge each Hoenn Leader again with six Pokémon at Level 98–100.
need: Hoenn League Champion.
quick: Visit a Hoenn Gym and talk to its Leader
They greet you, then ask: ‘Will you accept the rematch?’
Answer Yes or No
No closes the conversation with no battle and no cost.
Seven rematches are Single Battles; Tate & Liza remain a Double Battle.
Repeat as often as you like
The offer is available again immediately.

p: Each Leader has a second team of six. In the playthrough Roxanne was fought: a Single Battle led by Mega Aerodactyl at Level 98, paying ¥10,000, with the offer available again straight away.

The other seven rematch teams below come from the game’s trainer data. They were not fought in the playthrough, so the walk to each Leader and any puzzle state inside their Gym after the League is not confirmed here.
If you have not yet collected a Leader’s original Gym reward, they give it to you before offering the rematch.

stuck: How do I rematch Roxanne and the other Hoenn Leaders?
Become Hoenn Champion, then talk to the Leader in their Gym and answer Yes to ‘Will you accept the rematch?’
Can I decline a rematch?
Yes. Choose No and the conversation ends with no battle.
chapters.ev: v102 trace 208 (Roxanne); other seven: ROM trainer records 1470–1476

chapters.title: The S.S. Tidal
chapters.goal: Sail Hoenn’s ferry and learn how to finish the voyage.
need: Hoenn League Champion and the S.S. Ticket.
quick: Go to Slateport Harbor
Talk to the sailor and show your Ticket.
Choose Lilycove City
You board at once.
Rest in the bed in cabin No. 2
Walking the corridor does not end the voyage. The bed does.
Talk to the sailor at the exit
You have made land.

p: The Harbor sailor asks for your Ticket and offers a destination menu. On board, the corridor sailor tells you it will be some time before landfall and that your cabin is No. 2.

In the playthrough roughly 390 steps along the corridor did not finish the trip. Resting in the bed in cabin No. 2 ends it immediately: ‘We have made land in Lilycove City.’ Then talk to the sailor at the exit.
Trainers on board can be battled once each. Lilycove’s Harbor offers the return trip; its destination menu opens with the cursor on Exit.

stuck: The S.S. Tidal never arrives
Go to cabin No. 2 and rest in the bed. The ship then docks.
Where is the S.S. Tidal?
Slateport Harbor and Lilycove Harbor, after the Hoenn League. Talk to the sailor inside with the S.S. Ticket.

chapters.title: Steven & Wally
chapters.goal: Find Champion Steven and Wally for their final battles.
need: Hoenn League Champion.
quick: Champion Steven
Six Pokémon at Level 99–100, with Mega Metagross.
Wally
Five Pokémon at Level 98–100.

p: Both battles exist in the shipped game with the teams shown below. They were not fought in the playthrough, so this guide does not yet describe the route to them or the exact conditions; the places listed are the maps whose scripts start each battle.
Steven fights as Champion Steven, with Champion music and a ¥20,000 prize.

bosses.title: Champion Steven
know: Mega Metagross is Steel / Psychic: Fire, Ground, Ghost and Dark moves.

stuck: Where is Wally after the League?
His final team is in the game, but the playthrough did not reach that battle. The Trainer page lists the map its script is on.

chapters.title: Johto Leader Rematches
chapters.goal: Face the Johto Gym Leaders’ second teams.
need: Not confirmed. The battles are in the game; what opens the Dojo’s VIP room was not traced.
quick: Go to Saffron City’s Fighting Dojo
The Leaders gather in its VIP room.
Talk to a Leader and accept
Each has six Pokémon around Level 65–68.

p: Eight Johto Leaders have rematch teams in the trainer table, shown below. The rematches were not played in the natural run. The guide lists the teams and where the scripts live, and leaves the unlock condition unstated rather than guess.

stuck: How do I rematch the Johto Gym Leaders?
Their second teams are fought in the Saffron City Fighting Dojo. The condition that opens it is not confirmed in this guide yet.
chapters.ev: ROM trainer records; SaffronCity_FightingDojo scripts; not played

chapters.title: Legendary Pokémon
chapters.goal: Find and catch every Legendary and Mythical Pokémon the game offers.
need: Varies by Pokémon. Eighteen can be caught during the story, eleven after a milestone and three only after the Hoenn League.
quick: Open the field guide
Thirty-two entries, each with where to start, what you need, the steps, the encounter and what happens afterwards.
Save before each one
Fleeing is safe almost everywhere; Celebi’s shrine battle is the exception.
A knock-out is not final
Most return at your next League win as Kanto Champion. Kyogre, Groudon and Rayquaza follow Hoenn’s League instead.
Arceus is fought twice
Only the second battle can end in a capture.
stuck: Can I catch Groudon, Kyogre or Rayquaza during the story?

No. In the story they wake and leave. After the Hoenn League each waits at Level 85: Rayquaza on the Sky Pillar, Kyogre in the Marine Cave under Route 127 and Groudon in the Terra Cave on Route 114. One of each per save.
I knocked out a legendary Pokémon. Is it gone?
Not for good. Most return the next time you enter the Hall of Fame as Kanto Champion. Kyogre, Groudon and Rayquaza return after your next Hoenn League win instead.
I can’t throw a Poké Ball at Arceus
That is its first battle: Level 100, and it has to be knocked out. The second battle follows at once, at Level 80, and that one can be caught.
Where are Regirock, Regice and Registeel?
In the Sinjoh Ruins, not in Hoenn. Their chambers open as you collect plates in the Sinjoh story, which starts with the Azure Flute on Mt. Silver.
chapters.ev: content/legendaries.json, checked by tools/legendaries.py against the v105 ROM and the Pokédex availability audit; LEGENDARY-MYTHICAL-COMPLETENESS-AUDIT.md. Played: Ho-Oh (natural run)

chapters.title: The Alola Isles
chapters.goal: Reach the four Alola isles from Kanto and start Samson Oak’s survey.
need: Open from Kanto onwards: you do not have to finish any League first.
A Strange Souvenir, bought at the gift shop on Mt. Moon’s outdoor square.
A team around Level 60 for the isles’ strongest Pokémon; Samson Oak’s own team is Level 70.
quick: Buy a Strange Souvenir
The gift shop on Mt. Moon’s outdoor square sells it.
Talk to the captain on Route 13
He stands at the boat landing on the route’s southern shore, towards its east end.
Say yes to the ship
It lands you on Melemele Isle. Samson Oak meets you on the beach.
Visit Samson’s villa
On the east side of Melemele. His welcome there opens the rest of the isles’ stories.
Fly between the isles
All four isles can be flown to as soon as Samson has greeted you on the beach.

p: The Alola isles are a group of four small islands, Melemele, Akala, Ula’ula and Poni, that sit off Kanto’s coast. They are not part of the Hoenn story and need no Badge count: the only key is an item.
Go through Mt. Moon’s cave to its outdoor square and into the gift shop there. Among the drinks and Moon Stones it sells a Strange Souvenir. Buy one and keep it in your Bag.

On Route 13, between Lavender Town and Fuchsia City, a captain stands at a boat landing on the southern shore, towards the eastern end of the route. Without the souvenir he tells you the port is for residents only, and that all residents of the isles carry strange souvenirs.
With the souvenir in your Bag he takes you for an islander and offers the next ship. Answer Yes. On later visits he recognises you and simply asks whether you want to go to the Alola isles.
To come back, talk to the captain on Melemele’s southern beach, where you landed. He sails you to the same landing on Route 13.

As you step off the boat on Melemele Isle, Samson Oak, Professor Oak’s cousin, greets you and walks you up to the island’s town. He studies regional variants and has named these islands the Alola isles because so many Alolan Pokémon live here.

He asks you to come to his villa on the east side of the isle. Go inside: he welcomes you and asks you to help survey the isles. Until you have done this, the path beside the villa turns you back with a reminder that he is waiting.
Two things are now open: the survey below, and Lillie’s story, [[postgame/lillie|Something in Her Bag]], which starts in Melemele’s shop.

After Samson’s greeting on the beach, all four isles appear as green markers on the Johto and Kanto Fly map and can be flown to directly, including from the mainland. Melemele lands you beside its town; Akala on its eastern beach; Ula’ula on its western beach; Poni on its southern beach.
This was confirmed by the project’s automated tests of the Fly map, not by the natural playthrough.
Talk to Samson in the villa and choose an isle to report on. He checks your Pokédex for the Alolan variants that live there, and you need to have caught each one:

Melemele: Rattata, Raticate, Meowth and Persian. Akala: Raichu, Marowak, Diglett and Dugtrio. Ula’ula: Vulpix, Ninetales, Sandshrew, Sandslash, Grimer and Muk. Poni: Geodude, Graveler, Golem and Exeggutor.
Several of the evolved forms stand in the isles’ caves and forests as visible Level 60 Pokémon you walk up to. The isles’ place pages list the wild Pokémon in the grass and caves.

When all four isles are complete Samson asks for one more thing: each isle has a strange pillar guarded by a Totem Pokémon, fought as a Level 60 pair. With all four beaten he challenges you himself, with six Alolan Pokémon at Level 70. Afterwards he says the Tapu guardians have been seen flying over the isles and sends you back to the pillars, and when you have met all four he gives you a Beast Ball.

This outline is read from Samson’s script and dialogue. The exact position of each pillar and the day and night Totem pairs were not walked through for this guide. The four Tapu each have an entry in [[postgame/legendaries|the Legendary guide]].

Buy a Strange Souvenir at the gift shop on Mt. Moon’s outdoor square and talk to him again with it in your Bag.
I’m turned back near the villa on Melemele
Samson is waiting for you inside. Enter the villa on the east side of the isle and hear his welcome.
How do I get back to Kanto?
Talk to the captain on Melemele’s southern beach, where you landed, or Fly.
Is this postgame only?
No. It is listed here because it has no fixed place in the story. The boat runs as soon as you can reach Route 13 and Mt. Moon in Kanto.

chapters.title: Something in Her Bag
chapters.goal: Help Lillie find a safe home for the Vulpix she is hiding. An optional side story on the Alola isles.
need: You have reached the Alola isles and heard Samson Oak’s welcome inside his villa. See [[postgame/alola-isles|The Alola Isles]].
A team that can win two battles against Level 60 and Level 62 pairs.
Optional. Nothing else in the game depends on it.

Lillie is at the counter. Talk to her and agree to help.
Meet her just south-east of the villa’s front door
Talk to her. She lets a pale Vulpix out of her bag.
Ask Samson about Vulpix
Inside the villa, answer Yes when he asks if this is about Lillie.
Tell Lillie what he said
She leaves for Ula’ula.
Fly to Ula’ula and walk to the cave at the foot of Mt. Lanikala
Talk to Lillie outside it, then go in.
Find Vulpix a few steps east of the cave entrance
Talk to Vulpix, then to Lillie.

Go into the villa
The hearing plays. Talk to Lillie again for the reply.

Reward: a Shiny Charm, or five Rare Candies if you already own one.

p: Lillie’s story in Project Blonde is a short, self-contained side quest on the Alola isles. It is not the story from the official games: there is no Cosmog, no Aether Paradise to visit and no legendary Pokémon. It has eight stages across two islands, two Trainer battles and one reward.

It is optional and unlocks no area, Pokémon or later event. There is no timer, no escort and nothing you can permanently miss: every stage waits for you, you can save and leave at any point, and each character stays where the story left them until you return.
Lillie does not appear anywhere else in the game. She is not in Johto, Kanto or Hoenn.

steps.t: Stage 1: the girl in the shop
p: Once Samson Oak has welcomed you in his villa, walk into the shop in Melemele’s town, on the west side of the isle. A scene plays as you enter: a girl at the counter asks the clerk for something a little sweet and not too warm, for a friend who has had a difficult journey.

Talk to her. Something rustles in her bag. She introduces herself as Lillie and asks whether you could help her for a moment. Answer Yes and she says she will wait by the villa on the island’s east side, just south-east of its front door, and walks out.
If you answer No she stays in the shop. Talk to her again when you are ready.
Go to Samson’s villa on the east side of Melemele. Lillie is standing just south-east of the front door. Talk to her and she opens her bag: a pale Vulpix peeks out and steps onto the grass.
She asks whether you should give Vulpix a little room. Either answer is fine: Yes, and you step back; No, and you set a little food down instead. Both lead to the same place.

||Lillie explains that some researchers had Vulpix and that she took her away from them. She cannot keep her in a bag, and she is afraid to ask anyone for help.|| She asks whether Samson would listen.

Walk into the villa beside you and talk to Samson Oak. He asks: is this about Lillie and her Vulpix? Answer Yes. He suggests cool shelter, an icy cave at the foot of Mt. Lanikala on Ula’ula, and says her rare colour is not an illness.
If you answer No he carries on with his usual conversation about the isles and the survey, which is untouched by this story. Talk to him again to bring it up.
Go back outside and talk to Lillie. You pass on what Samson said, and she and Vulpix set off for Ula’ula. Vulpix now walks beside her instead of hiding.

Fly to Ula’ula Isle; you land on its western beach. Head east and a little south to the cave entrance at the foot of the mountain, in the southern part of the isle. Lillie and Vulpix are standing just below it.
Talk to Lillie. Vulpix keeps looking towards the cave, so the two of them go in ahead of you.
Enter the cave. Lillie waits by the entrance and, if you talk to her, says Vulpix has gone a little way east along the sheltered floor. There is no hurry and nothing to sneak past.
Walk a few steps east to find Vulpix playing in the snow and talk to her. She is at ease and looks back towards Lillie.

Return to Lillie and talk to her. ||She tells you the truth: the researchers work for Aether, they kept repeating tests on Vulpix because of her rare colouring, and she took Vulpix when she saw a transfer order. Aether’s president, Lusamine, is her mother.|| She decides to go back to Samson and explain it herself, and they leave for Melemele.

Fly back to Melemele and walk to the villa. As you approach the front door the scene starts: two Aether employees have found Lillie and have orders to collect Vulpix. Lillie refuses. Vulpix will not fight, so they challenge you instead.
Lillie asks whether you are ready and heals your team first. Answer Yes. The two battles follow one after the other, and your team is healed again after each:
First: Golbat and Kadabra, both Level 60. Second: Magneton and Hypno, both Level 62. Each is a Single Battle against one Trainer.

If you lose you are not sent away. Lillie tells you to catch your breath and you can try again by talking to her or walking back up to the door. A first battle you have already won stays won: you only repeat the one you lost. If you answer No, everyone waits where they are.
After the second win the employees agree to hear what Professor Samson has to say, and everyone goes inside. Follow them into the villa: the scene starts as you enter.

||Lillie hands over the test notes and the transfer order. Samson reads that the same tests were repeated again and again with no sign of illness, and one of the employees agrees the transfer should be suspended while it is reviewed. Samson says he will contact Wicke.|| The employees leave.

Talk to Lillie again, still inside the villa, for the reply. ||It is from Wicke: the transfer has been suspended and Vulpix may stay in Lillie’s care.|| No real-world waiting is needed between the two conversations. Lillie asks you to meet her outside.
Outside the villa, talk to Lillie one more time. Vulpix chooses to walk rather than go back in the bag, and Lillie gives you a Shiny Charm that Samson passed on for you.
If you already own a Shiny Charm you receive five Rare Candies instead. If your Bag has no room she keeps the gift safe: make space and talk to her again. It cannot be collected twice.
From then on Lillie and Vulpix stay outside the villa and greet you when you visit. Vulpix remains Lillie’s companion: you do not receive a Pokémon from this story.

Lillie’s story was not reached in the natural playthrough, which did not visit the Alola isles. Everything here comes from two sources. The stage order, conditions, choices, battles and reward are read from the story’s script and text in the current release candidate. The scenes, retries, full-Bag case and reward were also exercised by the project’s automated tests when the story was built, which set up each stage directly rather than playing from the start.
Directions on the ground (which way to walk on each isle) are read from the game’s maps and have not been walked. If one is unclear, the map above shows the island as the game draws it.

bosses.title: Aether employee (first)
know: Golbat’s Confuse Ray and Kadabra’s Reflect slow the fight down. Electric or Rock moves for Golbat, Dark or Bug for Kadabra.
Your party is healed before this battle and after it.

bosses.title: Aether employee (second)
know: Magneton has Sturdy and Thunder Wave: Ground moves hit it four times as hard, but it survives one hit at full HP.
Hypno’s Hypnosis can put your lead to sleep. A Dark type is immune to its Psychic.

items: From Lillie at the end of the story, if you do not already have one.
Five, from Lillie instead of the Shiny Charm if you already own one.
stuck: Lillie is not in the shop
Samson Oak must have welcomed you inside his villa first. If you have already agreed to help her, she has moved: look just south-east of the villa’s front door.
Samson only talks about the isles
He raises Vulpix only after Lillie has let her out of the bag outside the villa. If he asks ‘Is this about Lillie and her Vulpix?’ and you said No, talk to him again.
I can’t find Lillie on Ula’ula
She is at the cave entrance at the foot of the mountain, in the south of the isle, and only after you have told her what Samson said. Once you have spoken to her there, she is inside the cave.
Where is Vulpix in the cave?
A few steps east of the entrance, on the same floor. Talk to Vulpix, then go back and talk to Lillie.
I lost to the Aether employees
Nothing is lost. Talk to Lillie or walk up to the villa door to try again; a battle you already won is not repeated.
Lillie said my Bag is full
Make room and talk to her again outside the villa. The gift waits for you.
Can I get Lillie’s Vulpix?
No. Vulpix stays with Lillie. Alolan Vulpix can be caught on Ula’ula Isle.
Is there more to Lillie’s story?
Not in this release. The story ends with the reward, and Lillie stays outside the villa.

chapters.title: Far-off Places
chapters.sub: Sinjoh, the Safari Zones & the islands
chapters.goal: A map of the areas that sit outside the three regions’ main roads.
need: The Alola isles have their own chapter. The other areas here were not visited in the natural playthrough, except the Johto Safari Zone’s entrance.
quick: Alola isles
Melemele, Akala, Ula’ula and Poni. Reached by boat from Route 13: see [[postgame/alola-isles|The Alola Isles]].
Sinjoh
New Sinjoh, Routes 49–50, Snowswept Cavern and the Sinjoh Ruins.
Safari Zones
Johto’s (via Cianwood; entrance played), Kanto’s in Fuchsia, Hoenn’s on Route 121.
Islands
Southern Island and Birth Island.

p: Project Blonde contains whole areas beyond the three regions. Their maps, wild Pokémon, items and Trainers are in the game data and each has a page in the World atlas, linked below.

The Alola isles and the two stories set there have their own chapters: [[postgame/alola-isles|The Alola Isles]] and [[postgame/lillie|Something in Her Bag]]. How to reach the other areas was not verified. Rather than guess at tickets and triggers, this chapter points to the data: open a place to see its area maps and encounter tables, including the Alolan forms found on the isles.

stuck: How do I get to the Alola isles?
Buy a Strange Souvenir at Mt. Moon’s gift shop and talk to the captain on Route 13. See [[postgame/alola-isles|The Alola Isles]].
How do I get to Sinjoh?

From the game’s script: a researcher from the Pewter museum stands in the Pokémon Center outside Mt. Silver. If you are carrying the Azure Flute she offers to take you to a branch of the cave, which is where Sinjoh’s story begins. The Azure Flute is an item ball on Mt. Silver 2F, and the story is laid out step by step under ‘The seventeen plates of Sinjoh’ in [[postgame/legendaries|the Legendary guide]].
